paths_note: Link templates for the iOS app. Placeholders: {id} (TMDB id), {slug}, {title}, {year}, {season}, {episode}, {player}, {query}. Examples: /tv/213375/visionquest/season/1?e=2&p=1 and /movie/1368337/the-odyssey/watch?p=1. "player" is the query parameter that picks the site's player and "players" how many to offer. Empty = search the site instead.
